exposure: spermatozoa flagellum ultrastructural defects (dysplasia of the fibrous sheath [DFS], primary flagellar dyskinesia [PFD], non-specific flagellar abnormalities [NSFA])
cohort: The study included 189 ICSI cycles from 80 men with spermatozoa flagellum ultrastructural defects (DFS, PFD, NSFA) compared with 97 control men.
finding: No predictive value of spermatozoa flagellum ultrastructural defect phenotype was found on main ICSI outcomes (fertilization, pregnancy, delivery rates) or on increased risks of miscarriages, preterm births, low birth weights, or birth abnormalities.
